cases.title: Persistent synthetic regression
cases.criteria: 100 alternating synthetic turns; one live codec set/four SRCs/two workers; one EOO per turn; stale generations rejected. Does not satisfy speech gate.
cases.procedure: Run freedv_voice_engine_test --turns 100 at 8 kHz.

cases.title: Session lifecycle and recovery
cases.criteria: 100 enter/exit cycles; RX retune; overlapping PTT; drain repress; stale observations; held exit; preparation cancellation.
cases.procedure: Run the actual session coordinator against deterministic radio/device hooks.

cases.title: Reusable production PulseAudio lifecycle
cases.criteria: Partial writes, delayed/failed flush/drain, generation rejection, repeated rearm, one stream; cancellation independent of PA lock.
cases.procedure: Run the production audio.c mock-driver tests.

cases.title: Retained diagnostic controls
cases.criteria: All original diagnostic CTests pass; ownership, watchdog and recovery retain behavior.
cases.procedure: Run diagnostic CTests excluding new voice tests.

cases.title: 100 distinguishable speech turns
cases.criteria: 100 retained-context alternating turns; intelligible first/last words and turn identity; no stale speech, duplicate EOO, queue/resource growth; retained output.
cases.procedure: Run freedv_voice_runner --speech-list numbered-files.txt --turns 100 --rate RATE --output OUTPUT. Retain every original/modem/decoded turn, convert to declared WAV without changing rate, and record per-turn listening assessments. See integration-cases.md.

cases.title: 100 real engine/device lifetimes
cases.criteria: 100 entry/exit cycles; codec, resampler, stream, worker, descriptor counts return to baseline; ordinary turns create none.
cases.procedure: Run freedv_voice_engine_test --turns 1 --cycles 100 --rate 44100, then qualification/host_mode.py --build HOST --output NEW --turns 100 --cycles 100. Retain /proc resource counts and stream IDs; physical device lifetime qualification remains separate.

cases.title: Ten minutes valid modem receive
cases.criteria: Valid synchronized RX exercises FARGAN beyond old telemetry limit; interruptions/reacquisition; no audio termination from telemetry exhaustion.
cases.procedure: Run freedv_voice_runner --rx pinned-modem-s16le.raw --seconds 600 --rate 8000 --output NEW. Record fixture repetitions/EOO/outages, acquisitions, synchronized and synthesis blocks, counters and decoded output. Follow integration-cases.md.

cases.title: Cold, warm and idle turns
cases.criteria: Cold entry, warm subsequent turn and after idle all preserve first/last words and context lifetimes.
cases.procedure: Follow integration-cases.md: cold entry preserving both VFO frequencies, subsequent turns, then 60 s RX idle and another numbered turn. Retain first-block/release timings and listening.

cases.title: Short tap and mid-frame release
cases.criteria: Accepted speech including <200 ms is finalized; only final partial frame padded; one EOO and 200 ms silence; release does not truncate accepted input.
cases.procedure: Run ctest -R freedv_voice_engine, freedv_voice_audio and freedv_voice_session; in the assembled candidate release at 20/90/150/230 ms and mid-modem-frame using numbered speech. Retain accepted-sample/EOO/tail accounting and recordings.

cases.title: Ordinary fading
cases.criteria: Reacquisition without receiver recreation; decoder initialization and normalization match pinned reference.
cases.procedure: Follow integration-cases.md: interrupt identified modem input for 0.2/1/5 s, restore it and repeat during speaker playback; log sync loss/reacquisition and unchanged receiver creation counts. Hardware claims require a transmitting RF source.

cases.title: Engine failure injection
cases.criteria: Queue saturation, encoder/decoder/synthesis failure report fault; Stop during preparation/backpressure bypasses codec progress; bounded queues.
cases.procedure: Run ctest -R freedv_voice_faults and freedv_voice_session. Test-only hooks inject encoder, decoder and synthesis failures into the actual engine; assert bounded saturated queues and Stop during blocked finish/preparation. Attach assembled-app recovery observations.

cases.title: Production adapter failure injection
cases.criteria: Partial writes, delayed callbacks, capture holes/errors, failed drain and cancellation cannot deliver stale audio or recreate streams per turn.
cases.procedure: Run ctest -R freedv_voice_audio, freedv_audio_playback and freedv_audio_capture. Exercise delayed/partial writes, failed drain/flush, capture errors, and cancellation racing rearm; then run host_mode.py for real PA stream lifecycles.

cases.title: Timeout and release lockout
cases.criteria: Default 180 seconds and bounds 30..600 persist; timeout clears software TX independently and requires all sources to release; stale queued presses invalidated.
cases.procedure: Run ctest -R freedv_voice_timeout for the real 30 s timeout and both-source release lockout; session tests cover 30..600 s limits and an independently stalled 1.5 s drain. Repeat both physical sources on the candidate per integration-cases.md.

cases.title: Ownership/tuning guard integration
cases.criteria: Local RX frequency, band, VFO, volume and permitted receive controls work; all TX/drain/recovery tuning rejected before settings/hardware mutation; CAT/TCI/web, memories and hardware writes covered.
cases.procedure: Run ctest -R freedv_voice_radio and freedv_voice_writer, then host_mode.py. RX tune/band/VFO/memory/volume; try each again during TX/drain/recovery and through CAT/TCI/web; verify settings and hardware before/after.

cases.title: Competing apps and remote TX
cases.criteria: Audio apps, independent/remote TX rejected while owned; diagnostics retain stricter ownership.
cases.procedure: Follow integration-cases.md: attempt recorder/digital-audio apps, CAT/TCI/browser TX and direct control writes in RX/TX/drain/recovery. Run freedv_voice_radio and freedv_voice_writer tests; no competing path may mutate settings or key.

cases.title: Asynchronous mode replacement
cases.criteria: Destination app opening, generic destruction and restoration wait for shutdown; no old app-memory frequency restored.
cases.procedure: Run host_mode.py: request Modes while TX/PTT holds, verify EXITING retains ownership, release PTT and verify destination opening only after OFF. Repeat generic close, Stop during preparation/drain, and another app shortcut.

cases.title: SSB/DIGI and VFO restoration
cases.criteria: Snapshot every touched VFO/mode context with deliberately different saved SSB/DIGI settings; restore owned overrides preserving current frequency/VFO/permitted receive changes.
cases.procedure: Run freedv_voice_radio and host_mode.py; follow integration-cases.md with deliberately different saved USB/DIGI and A/B settings, RX band/VFO changes, volume changes and held exit/restart. Compare DB and cached commands without restoring entry frequency.

cases.title: Preferences and bookmarks
cases.criteria: Action126/type6 stable; 17 GUI HF seeds; edits/deletions preserved; bookmark changes frequency only; USB/USB-DIG storage cannot bypass profile; ordinary mic preferences retained; persisted TX never resumes.
cases.procedure: Run freedv_voice_bookmarks and freedv_voice_radio; edit/add/delete/duplicate bookmarks in native UI and web editor. Check action 126/type 6, 17 seeds, stored USB/USB-DIG modes ignored on recall, timeout limits, mic preferences and persisted TX never resumed.

cases.procedure: Build supported sanitizer targets and report failures versus unavailable runtime separately.

cases.procedure: Follow matched-profiles.md with local diagnostic arming; maximum 10 second RF diagnostic cases. Record failed/inconclusive routes separately; never combine profile halves.

cases.title: Fixed versus live RF
cases.criteria: Repeat fixed waveform and live microphone comparisons on candidate; no unexplained loss/stale speech/in-speech underflows or sustained backlog.
cases.procedure: Follow matched-profiles.md and operating-guide.md; keep raw evidence and independent listening assessment.

cases.title: Two minute live-path measurement
cases.criteria: Measure two minutes under normal GUI/waterfall load; record cold/warm first block, PTT-valid modem, release-RX, acquisition, CPU/RSS and backlog. Historical 70% margin failure remains distinct.
cases.procedure: Follow matched-profiles.md and operating-guide.md; keep raw evidence and independent listening assessment.

cases.title: Ten turn conversation
cases.criteria: Ten turns in approximately 5..10 minutes; intelligible bidirectional speech, beginning/end content, no stale speech or resource growth.
cases.procedure: Follow matched-profiles.md and operating-guide.md; keep raw evidence and independent listening assessment.

cases.title: Physical PTT and restart recovery
cases.criteria: Both controls, overlap, timeout, Stop, held/released restart; software TX cleared at startup; analog restoration waits for fresh RX and independent releases; held/unknown shown.
cases.procedure: Follow matched-profiles.md and operating-guide.md; keep raw evidence and independent listening assessment.

cases.title: Final controlled RF receive
cases.criteria: GUI-originated controlled external RF decodes while X6200 speaker operates. Receive-only SDR cannot supply this input.
cases.procedure: Follow matched-profiles.md and operating-guide.md; keep raw evidence and independent listening assessment.

cases.title: Final RF transmit
cases.criteria: X6200 live hand speech received/decoded by complete official GUI through RF, intelligible first/last words.
cases.procedure: Follow matched-profiles.md and operating-guide.md; keep raw evidence and independent listening assessment.

cases.title: Software abort to actual RF off
cases.criteria: Conservative physical event-to-RF cessation upper bound, including uncertainty, <=500 ms. Software timestamps alone cannot pass. Held physical PTT measured separately.
cases.procedure: Follow timing.md. Use validated correlated video/IQ only if it bounds the entire initiating-event to RF interval; otherwise synchronized trigger/RF-envelope instrumentation.

cases.title: Sample-accounting analysis self-test
cases.criteria: Known gaps, delays, clipping and discontinuities detected with fixture-proven accuracy; counts refer to expected reference and clock boundaries.
cases.procedure: Run test_kit.py plus analysis fixtures; hardware setup requires actual equipment report.

cases.title: Collector negative tests
cases.criteria: Mismatched builds/profiles, missing recordings and incomplete runs rejected; intelligibility unassessed until listening review.
cases.procedure: Run test_kit.py plus analysis fixtures; hardware setup requires actual equipment report.

cases.title: End-to-end evidence rehearsal
cases.criteria: Preflight/run/collect/assess completed on rehearsal bundle; marked rehearsal and never radio qualification.
cases.procedure: Run test_kit.py plus analysis fixtures; hardware setup requires actual equipment report.

cases.title: Actual hardware RF/timing setup validation
cases.criteria: Verify timing and RF fixture methods on actual equipment; operator intervals and unverified uncertainty alone insufficient.
cases.procedure: Validate the actual dummy-load/attenuation/SDR and event/RF timing setup using known signals and correlated triggers on the actual equipment; follow timing.md and matched-profiles.md. Record calibration, delays, uncertainties, fixture identities and hashes. Software self-tests cannot pass this gate.
